name: sol_defi_as_6
description: Arbitrary external call/delegatecall using user-controlled target or data
question: The source file in `source` contains a function that performs an external call, delegatecall, or low-level call using a target address and/or call data supplied directly from user input, without validating or restricting the target address, function selector, or call data against a trusted allowlist, enabling callers to make the contract execute arbitrary logic on arbitrary targets, excluding cases where the caller is a privileged trusted admin/owner-only function or the target/selector is validated against an allowlist or hardcoded set.
criteria: A function calls target.call(data) where both target and data are parameters taken directly from external caller input with no allowlist check
A swap/execute function performs address(dexRouter).call(userSuppliedBytes) using a router address and payload passed in by msg.sender without restricting the router or selector
A proxy/forwarder function does delegatecall(msg.data) or delegatecall(userInput) to a user-specified implementation address without verifying it against a trusted registry
A batch/multicall function loops over user-provided (target, data) pairs and executes low-level calls to each without checking targets belong to a permitted set
